name: Lonely Christmas: Cupid's Punishment
source:
On the North Pole, there exists a secret civilization run by Santa who's purpose is to spread the Christmas spirit. Your job is to produce presents for Christmas Day, but you've fallen behind your quota, and now Santa has ordered one of her helpers, Cupid, to punish you. However, the "punishment" that Cupid has in mind for you is far from painful.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3398690/Lonely_Christmas_Cupids_Punishment/?curator_clanid=45331749] Steam[/url]]
